info.name: OMS-360 Enterprise QA Collection
info.description:
Enterprise Newman/Postman regression suite for the OMS-360 Food Delivery Platform.

Generated directly from live FastAPI route source (app/routes/*.py, app/api/ai/*.py) on 2026-08-04 - every request matches a real endpoint and real Pydantic schema. No fabricated or placeholder APIs.

50 JSON API requests across 6 functional folders, plus 5 optional HTML dashboard-page smoke checks in a clearly separate 7th folder.

Run order matters: Orders/Inventory/AI Copilot folders capture ids (order_id, item_id, intent, learning_topic) from list/catalog responses into environment variables, consumed by later detail requests in the same run.
